query: I spent the whole weekend baking sourdough, I finally got the starter just right so the loaf had that perfect crispy crust and soft, airy crumb, and I even brought a slice in to share with my coworker this morning. On the way to the office, I saw a golden retriever puppy wearing a tiny raincoat, it was so cute I stopped to pet it for five whole minutes, and the owner said it’s only 12 weeks old and still learning to walk on a leash. I’m having trouble with my phone service right now, I realized airplane mode is turned on, my APN settings seem to be broken, and my SIM card is locked with a PIN so I can’t get any network connection, I hope you can help me fix this.
